derived: Converted from the 1.1.6 RP2040 golden script (edf11eb) by the same mapping as the RP2350 script, offline. Never replayed on an RP2040 and no reference has been captured; run capture on an RP2040 before using compare.
note: Paged requests. dir G is a GET of len bytes, S a SET of payload (hex). settle waits after the request: delay_ms, then poll ready (SYS.PLATFORM answers) or cs (CS.STATUS byte 0 leaves PENDING).
